arabic text: MUJRAE KHALQ MEIN, IN ANKHON NE KYA KYA DEKHA\nPAR KAHIN SIBT-E-PAYAMBAR SA NA AQA DEKHA
english translation text: IN THE SPECTACLE OF CREATION, WHAT HAVE THESE EYES NOT SEEN?\nYET NOWHERE HAVE THEY SEEN A MASTER LIKE THE PROPHET'S GRANDSON

arabic text: AIK GHATRI SHAH-E-DEEN PUSHT PE LAAYE US MEIN\nMAINE TUKDE HUWE QASIM KA SARAPA DEKHA
english translation text: THE KING OF FAITH CARRIED A BUNDLE UPON HIS BACK; WITHIN IT\nI SAW QASIM'S WHOLE BLESSED FORM, TORN INTO PIECES

arabic text: MAINE DEKHA ALAM-E-SHAH KO ALUDA-E-KHOON\nMAINE ABBAS KO BEJAAN LAB-E-DARYA PE DEKHA
english translation text: I SAW THE SHAH'S STANDARD STAINED WITH BLOOD\nI SAW ABBAS LYING LIFELESS BY THE RIVERBANK

arabic text: MAINE DEKHA ALI ASGHAR KA GALA KHOON MEIN TAR\nMAINE ZAKHMI ALI AKBAR KA KALEJA DEKHA
english translation text: I SAW ALI ASGHAR'S THROAT SOAKED IN BLOOD\nI SAW THE WOUNDED HEART OF ALI AKBAR

arabic text: MAINE DEKHA SHAH-E-MAZLOOM KO KHANJAR KE TALE\nMAINE BE-GOR-O-KAFAN BHAI KA LASHA DEKHA
english translation text: I SAW THE OPPRESSED SHAH BENEATH THE DAGGER\nI SAW MY BROTHER'S BLESSED BODY WITHOUT BURIAL OR SHROUD

arabic text: MUJRAE KHALQ MEIN, IN ANKHON NE KYA KYA DEKHA\nPAR KAHIN SIBT-E-PAYAMBAR SA NA AQA DEKHA
english translation text: IN THE SPECTACLE OF CREATION, WHAT HAVE THESE EYES NOT SEEN?\nYET NOWHERE HAVE THEY SEEN A MASTER LIKE THE PROPHET'S GRANDSON
